written_from: user prompt only (critic never sees the designer's reasoning or code)
rationale: Part must compile to a valid STL to be printable.
Part must fit on a standard 256mm printer bed.
Walls of at least 1.2mm ensure printed legs/body do not snap in handling.
Minimum bounding box ensures a recognizable mini dog, not a flat token or fragment.
Maximum bounding box keeps it mini and handheld, not a full-size dog model.
Minimum volume ensures substantial solid material for body, head and legs.
Maximum volume prevents an oversized solid block wasting material.
At least one complete part must be present in the model.
